strings.text: He was an old man who fished alone in a skiff in the Gulf Stream.
strings.translation: Era um velho que pescava sozinho num bote na Corrente do Golfo.

strings.text: Fish, I love you and respect you very much. But I will kill you dead before this day ends.
strings.translation: Peixe, eu te amo e te respeito muito. Mas vou te matar antes que este dia acabe.

strings.text: I wish I had the boy.
strings.translation: Quem me dera ter o garoto aqui.

strings.text: He is two feet longer than the skiff.
strings.translation: Ele é dois pés mais comprido que o bote.
